resources.string: Distance is a rough signal-based estimate, not a precise measurement. Some devices do not report signal strength.
Permission denied. Allow nearby devices and Wi-Fi access to scan.
A permission request is already open. Finish it before starting another scan.
Permission request finished after switching modes. Start the selected scan again.
Permission request finished, but the scan was canceled. Press Start to begin.
This phone does not have Bluetooth.
Turn on Bluetooth in phone settings, then start scanning again.
Scanning nearby devices until you stop.
Scanning Wi-Fi and Bluetooth nearby. Bluetooth continues until stopped.
Scanning stopped; Bluetooth permission was revoked.
Bluetooth scan stopped, but Android reported a cleanup issue. Toggle Bluetooth if scanning continues.
Wi-Fi scan running in the background. Tap Stop to finish.
Bluetooth scan running in the background. Tap Stop to finish.
Visible notification for an active Wi-Fi or Bluetooth scan.
Scan continues, but notifications are blocked. Allow notifications to see the background Stop control.
This phone does not provide Wi-Fi scanning.
Wi-Fi scanning is unavailable. Restart Wi-Fi and try again.
Android limited this scan. Showing latest available results.
Wi-Fi is turned off. Turn it on and try again.
Turn on Location in phone settings to allow Wi-Fi scanning.
No networks returned. Check Wi-Fi and Location settings, then scan again.
Refreshing cached results. Android is rate-limiting new Wi-Fi scans.
Wi-Fi results are unavailable because permission was denied.
Bluetooth scan failed (error %1$d). Check Bluetooth permissions.
Tap a result to copy its details.
Compass ready. Point the top of your phone forward.
This phone does not provide a compass sensor.
No compass sensor. GPS direction works only while moving with precise location.
Compass showing the direction the top of the phone faces.
The compass sensor shows magnetic direction while standing still. GPS gives your position and can report travel direction only while moving.
GPS: waiting for a location fix…
GPS location permission is needed to show coordinates.
Turn on Location services in phone settings.
GPS location is unavailable on this phone.
GPS course: move to detect travel direction.
Radar scanning nearby Wi-Fi and Bluetooth devices.
Radar stopped. Tap Start Wi-Fi + Bluetooth radar to scan again.
The Wi-Fi and Bluetooth radar could not start.
Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and location permissions are needed for radar.
Wi-Fi and Bluetooth radar scan running. Tap Stop to finish.
Nearby Wi-Fi and Bluetooth signals arranged by relative signal strength. Dot positions are illustrative, not device directions.
Looking for nearby Wi-Fi and Bluetooth…
…and %1$d more. Strongest signals are shown first.
Signals show relative strength only; this radar cannot tell which direction a device is in.
Bluetooth LE scanner unavailable; trying classic Bluetooth.
Bluetooth scanning is unavailable. Restart Bluetooth and try again.
Classic Bluetooth scan could not start; BLE scan remains active.
Measure a device at a known distance, then enter its RSSI reading. Use the same device and radio type for best results.
Enter distance greater than 0 and at most 1000 m, RSSI -120–0 dBm, and environment factor 1–6.
